*181. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:

FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:

have not renewed/given permission to some

period?

students

the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:

and a stipend granted to students belonging

*195. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:

WARI: Will the Minister of SHIPPING be

wise; and
(c) the immediate and corrective steps
being taken to avoid the losses on a
permanent basis?
Study on juvenile delinquency
*197. SHRI C. M. IBRAHIM:
DR. KARAN SINGH:

AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:

delinquency in different States in the
country has been conducted;

are being created for this purpose; and

launching an information campaign for this
purpose so that public could know what
to do in an emergency and where to go for
treatment later?
